title: Book Three · Chapter 12: Noodles for Three
story:
On Sunday afternoon, Dad puts a bowl of flour on the kitchen table.

Ronan stops in the doorway.

“Are you making something?”

“Noodles.”

“We have dry noodles.”

“I know. Today I want these.”

Dad adds water to the flour. He mixes it with one hand. For a while, most of it sticks to his fingers.

Ronan watches.

“Is that right?”

“Ask me in ten minutes.”

Mum comes in with her bag. She is going to meet her friend. They want to look at some cloth together.

She looks at Dad's hand.

“Do you need help?”

“No. But I may need a new hand.”

Mum laughs. She brushes a little flour from his sleeve and leaves them to it.

Soon the mixture becomes a soft ball. Dad presses it against the table. He turns it and presses again.

Ronan washes his hands.

“Can I try that part?”

Dad moves aside. The soft ball feels cool under Ronan's hands. He pushes too hard. One end slides toward the edge.

Dad catches it.

“We need dinner on the table first.”

Ronan pulls it back. This time, he uses less force.

They leave it in the bowl for a while. Dad covers the bowl with a clean cloth. Then he washes some green vegetables.

Ronan gets three bowls from the shelf. He puts them on the table outside the small kitchen.

When Dad uncovers the bowl, Ronan comes back. Together they press the dough flat. Dad rolls it into a wide sheet.

He folds the sheet and takes a knife. Ronan steps back.

Dad cuts narrow strips. Some are thin. Some are wide.

“These two are very different,” Ronan says.

“They are not school rulers. They can be different.”

Ronan picks up one strip and pulls the folded ends apart. It becomes a long noodle. He lays it on the table.

Soon noodles cover most of the clean space.

Dad heats water. Ronan moves away from the stove and carries the vegetables to the table.

Mum comes home with a small piece of cloth and three pears.

She stops at the kitchen door.

“Where can I put these?”

Ronan looks at the noodles.

“On a chair, maybe.”

Dad drops the first handful into the hot water. A few minutes later, the table is clear again.

They eat in the yard. Ronan finds one very wide noodle in his bowl. He lifts it for Dad to see.

“That one is yours,” Dad says.

“How do you know?”

“I don't. But I can try.”

Mum tells them about a bright yellow cloth in the shop. Dad asks about the price. She says it cost too much for her plan.

Ronan takes another mouthful. The noodles are soft and warm. When he finishes, he carries his bowl back for more.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

flour＝面粉；stick to＝黏在……上；dough＝面团；strip＝长条。

## 理解问题

1. Dad为什么在家里已有干面条时还动手做面？
2. Ronan参加了哪些步骤？谁使用刀具并处理热水？

## 读句子

**Dad covers the bowl with a clean cloth.**

拆开看：Dad / covers the bowl / with a clean cloth.

Dad／把碗盖住／用一块干净的布。
